brief: How to have a perfect glow skin — 5 steps from a dermatologist.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.subtitle: FIVE DERMATOLOGIST-APPROVED STEPS TO RADIANT SKIN

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: GENTLE CLEANSE
slots.body: Start with a mild, pH-balanced cleanser to remove impurities without stripping natural oils. Massage in circular motions and rinse with lukewarm water.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: EXFOLIATE WEEKLY
slots.body: Use a chemical exfoliant with AHAs or BHAs two to three times per week. This removes dead cells and reveals a brighter, smoother complexion.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: HYDRATE DEEPLY
slots.body: Apply a hyaluronic acid serum to damp skin, then lock it in with a lightweight moisturizer. Well-hydrated skin reflects light and looks naturally plump.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: SHIELD DAILY
slots.body: Broad-spectrum SPF is the final and most important step every single morning. It prevents dark spots, premature aging, and maintains your healthy glow.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: REST AND NOURISH
slots.body: Prioritize seven to nine hours of quality sleep and drink plenty of water. A balanced diet rich in antioxidants supports your skin from within.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: YOUR GLOW AWAITS
slots.body: Consistency is the secret to lasting radiance. Follow these simple steps daily, and your skin will thank you with a luminous, healthy glow.
